import re,html
t=open('products/distribution/accountless-route/raw/archive-help-save-pages.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
t=re.sub(r'(?s)<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t)
x=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t))
x=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',x)
for k in ['Save Page Now','log','account','anonymous','automat','robot','API','/save']:
  for m in re.finditer(re.escape(k),x):
    print('##',k,':',x[max(0,m.start()-200):m.start()+250]);break
